modalities.evidence: multishell diffusion and perfusion imaging techniques
IDH mutation status and MGMT promoter methylation status
overall survival and progression free survival information

output.population: 243 timepoints from 178 subjects (mean age 56 +/- 13 years [std], 116 men, 62 women) with histopathologically-proven high-grade gliomas
output.summary: Post-operative brain MRI from patients with high-grade glioma, imaged on 3 Tesla scanners with 3D, diffusion and perfusion sequences, plus tumor segmentations, IDH and MGMT status, and survival information.
